Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** an SSO login reads English on a zh-CN console. It is the second occurrence of the class objectui#10900 closed, so the enumeration pin the card asks for is in scope.
- **For the claimant:** The landings are both hosts' `labels` blocks and the ten `auth.login.*` bundles. Serial with PR #12761 (#12682) on `LoginForm`.

Claim: PM loop round 2

File surface: the `labels` each host passes `@object-ui/auth`'s `LoginForm`, in `apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx` and `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/LoginPage.tsx` (`DefaultLoginPage`); the `auth.login.*` section of the ten `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` bundles, for the four SSO members (`ssoOnlyDescription`, `usePasswordText`, `backToSsoText`, `ssoButton`) only; tests beside each, including one enumeration pin over `LoginFormLabels`; one `.changeset/12762-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report). ⛔ `LoginForm.tsx` itself does not change.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the named paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (no export, prop or type changes; the hosts pass members `LoginFormLabels` already declares)
Responsibility: the console's `LoginPage` and app-shell's `DefaultLoginPage` pass `LoginForm` no SSO labels, and no bundle has keys for them, so `LoginForm`'s English fallbacks show on a zh-CN console. `DefaultLoginPage` also omits the ten phone and OTP labels the console passes | none covers it | every user of an SSO login on a non-English console, measured on zh-CN for `ssoOnlyDescription` and `usePasswordText` by the objectui#12682 dev (PR #12761); the label blocks stand on `main` `020d178`
Thread-read: 6222754910
Serial constraints cleared:
- PR objectui#12761 (objectui#12682), which triage named as serial, landed `9b69e13`.
- objectui#12712 (`pm:retriage`, no PR) would touch `LoginForm.tsx`, which this card does not.
- objectui#12703 (another seat, in flight) names `packages/i18n/src/locales` for list-block keys. It is a different region of the same bundles, so serial by region: whichever lands second merges `main`.
- No other in-flight `domain:ui` claim and no open objectui PR names either login page, read across the lane's `pm:dispatched` claims and all 7 open PRs' file lists 2026-10-16T21:06Z.
